The KB record’s canonical symbol Ku and definition match the problem’s Ku, so the candidate’s dimensionless exponents are supported.

The ledger ES (effective streamwise slope) corresponds to KB entry pq_effective_surface_slope, which defines mean absolute surface slope (a derivative of height with respect to horizontal distance) and explicitly lists si_dimension: 1 because a length divided by a length is dimensionless. The KB symbol ES and the provided definition match the ledger’s ES and validate the candidate’s all-zero exponents.

variables.physical_definition: First-order absolute moment of surface height fluctuations (mean absolute deviation of heights).
Peak-to-valley height (difference between highest and lowest surface height).
Root-mean-square height of surface roughness (square root of mean square height).
Dimensionless skewness: third central moment of height fluctuations normalized by the cube of RMS height.
Dimensionless kurtosis of height fluctuations.
Effective streamwise slope of the roughness (vertical change per unit streamwise length).
Surface porosity (fraction of surface area that is void).
